Represent each of the vectors on the plane below as a column vector

<div data-components="unitSteps"></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 3.2 · p. 17</div>

::: notes
The applet recreates the booklet diagram at the original coordinates: a runs from (0,1) to (1,3), b from (2,−2) to (−3,−3), and c from (−2,1) to (−3,4). Count changes from each arrow's own tail, not the coordinates of its head. Each Show button reveals individual unit vectors added head to tail, horizontal steps first, then vertical steps, plus component and column forms. a=i+j+j=i+2j=(1,2); b=−i−i−i−i−i−j=−5i−j=(−5,−1); c=−i+j+j+j=−i+3j=(−1,3). Each reveal is reversible and Reset all hides all three paths and answers.
:::
